launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.3.3 Nightfall polish: dark themed backdrop over the vanilla dirt (input dialogs on Multiplayer and every other menu no longer sit on a light grey background), HUD-editor wordmark moved clear of the K logo, boxy mod menu gains category tabs (All/HUD/Mechanic/Visual/Tweaks), per-module settings gear always opens the config, right-click/long-press on a module tile opens its configuration, friendlier settings pages.
